name: Feedback
abilities: Bio-electrokinesis - electrical beams, waves, charged electricity bombs and explosions
Energy absorption and redirection through plug-tipped fingers, tendrils and tail (electricity, tachyon-cannon beams, manna, Crystalsapien energy)
Energy conversion - absorbed energy supercharges his blasts (overpowered Malware's Tachyon Cannon after draining the Helix)
Electricity-enhanced punches and electrokinetic propulsion through the air
Electricity conductivity - runs along power lines at extreme speed
Elastic, strong tendrils and tail (plugs into foes to electrocute them; knocked over Terroranchula Phil)
Enhanced strength (lifted Terroranchula Phil, busted through a wall)
Enhanced durability (shrugged off a giant Malware's blast)
Enhanced jumping, acrobatics and reflexes (batted an Ultimate Humungousaur missile back)
Radiolocation - 'smells' radio signals with his tendrils
weaknesses: Electric blasts are ineffective against foes that absorb electricity (Phil/Terroranchula)
Once his blasts are charged he cannot stop firing them - risk of collateral damage (Breakpoint)
Unknown upper limit to how much energy he can absorb
Prolonged proximity to several male Conductoids can generate a lethal arc (species lore)
summary: Ben's black, one-eyed Conductoid with plug-tipped fingers, antennae and tail that drinks in energy and fires it back as electricity - 11-year-old Ben's favourite alien, destroyed by Malware and regained five years later.
traits: Single green eye and two antenna-tendrils with plugs
One of only three aliens with their own theme song
The last alien 16-year-old Ben used on-screen in the Classic continuity
Only Feedback and Diamondhead ever defeated Malware
notableFeats: Defeated Malware in his first appearance (The More Things Change: Part 1)
Absorbed the Helix and overpowered Malware's Tachyon Cannon, destroying Malware for good with Azmuth's help (Showdown: Part 2)
Defeated Negative Ultimate Humungousaur, knocking its own missile back at it (A Fistful of Brains)
Reverted Phil from his Terroranchula form twice (Max's Monster; Weapon XI: Part 1)
Defeated Argost (T.G.I.S.) and located Liam via radio signals (Clyde 5)
Absorbed and redirected the Annihilarrgh's energy, trapping Maltruant in an eternal time loop (A New Dawn)

notableEpisodes: Let's Do the Time War Again
appearances.designNotes: 16-year-old: black body, one green eye, two plug-tipped antenna-tendrils and tail, GREEN chest, square-plug fingers, gold battery bolts on shoulders/arms/hips, Omnitrix on chest. 11-year-old (flashbacks, first six appearances): identical but WHITE chest and round finger plugs, original Omnitrix on chest.

image.label: OV
image.notes: Infobox render, 16-year-old design (823x1160, transparent). 11-year-old flashback design render: 'Feedback as 11 Years Old.png' (1296x1832); 'Feedback official2.png' (4096x5568) is an 11-year-old action pose.

scoring.rationale: Energy 8: absorbs anything from Megawhatt sparks to the Annihilarrgh and fires it back supercharged - it destroyed Malware and beat Maltruant. Offense 7 with beams, bombs and electrified punches that hurt Mechamorphs and Ultimates; speed 6 riding power lines. Purely a fighter with average toughness; charged blasts can't be cancelled and electricity absorbers shrug him off.

notes: In-universe Feedback was unlocked off-screen after Destroy All Aliens and used by 11-year-old Ben, but every on-screen appearance is in Omniverse (flashbacks + present), so debut series is 'ov' with debut usedBy ben-11-ov; no OS appearance record.

Malware storyline: 11-year-old Ben's Feedback was forcibly removed and destroyed by Malware in the flashback of Showdown: Part 1; 16-year-old Ben regained him from Malware's body in Showdown: Part 2 (first 16-year-old use). Crew disagree on the mechanism (locked vs removed from the Codon Stream vs absorbed genetic code); Albedo and Mad Ben do not have Feedback.
Feedback was intended to be the reason Ben quit hero work between OS and AF, but Cartoon Network vetoed the idea.
Malgax Attacks: Skurd gave Whampire Feedback's arms - not a transformation. Max's Monster second use is an 11-year-old flashback cameo.
Dimension 23 counterpart exists (Ben 23's Feedback, originally 'Plug Man'). Video-game/online-game/comic uses (Omniverse games, FusionFall Heroes, Super Secret Crisis War!) not counted.
